plan.title: After legacy upgrade (0.126.2 → 0.127.0) doctor fails manifest-agreement on leftover xbrief/.deft-version

narratives.Description: OVPR fix plan unit P2-U2 (story id ovpr-p2-u2), spec units/P2-U2-doctor-green-after-old-repo-upgrade.md, issue #6001 (also #6503 item 3), decision D-022. After `directive upgrade` of an old repo, `directive doctor --full` fails `manifest-agreement` on the leftover `xbrief/.deft-version` and advises `deft update`, which loops. Part A makes doctor ignore the marker in OVPR projects (pin present, no .deft/core); Part B makes old-layout conversion delete each version-only marker (`xbrief/.deft-version`, root `.deft-version`, `vbrief/.deft-version`) and list it in the upgrade report.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
After a successful legacy upgrade (0.126.2 → 0.127.0), doctor fails with `manifest-agreement` because `xbrief/.deft-version` from the old layout is left behind. Uninstall then reinstall doesn't clear it.

## Steps
Existing app, `directive init` with 0.126.2 (`.deft/core` deposit), commit, `npm i -g @deftai/directive@0.127.0`, `directive upgrade --yes` (exit 0, "This project now uses Directive 0.127.0"), then `directive doctor --full`.

## Actual
Exit 1: `✗ manifest-agreement: fail -- Bare .deft-version exists at …/xbrief/.deft-version but YAML manifest is missing at …node_modules\@deftai\directive-runtime…`. The header still says `directive doctor: in sync`. Still present after `directive uninstall` + `directive install`.

## Expected
Upgrade retires or migrates the legacy marker, or the check ignores it under OVPR.

## Root cause
- Cause: the upgrade's legacy removal covers `.deft/core` but not `xbrief/.deft-version`, and the core `manifest-agreement` check still treats a bare `.deft-version` as an install manifest when there is no `.deft/core`.
- Evidence: doctor output; the file remains after upgrade, uninstall and reinstall.
- Confidence: likely (behavior confirmed; check source not read).
- Checked: upgrade, doctor, uninstall, reinstall, doctor.

## Environment
- Directive 0.127.0 (`@deftai/directive` launcher + `@deftai/directive-runtime`), `latest` dist-tag
- Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200, Node 24.20.0, npm 11.19.0, pnpm 10.33.2, Git for Windows (system gitconfig `core.autocrlf=true`)
- Shells: Git Bash, PowerShell 7, cmd.exe. Isolated npm prefix/cache; registry = local Verdaccio proxying npmjs. Throwaway fixture repos.
narratives.UserStory: As a developer who upgraded an old Directive repo, I want doctor to stop failing on the leftover .deft-version marker and the upgrade to remove that marker, so that a supported upgrade ends with a green doctor and no loop of advice.
narratives.StoryId: ovpr-p2-u2 (carried in the file name so the ordered plan can match it; plan.id stays the id minted from the issue, because the brief tools refuse a different plan.id)
narratives.UnitSpec: ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/units/P2-U2-doctor-green-after-old-repo-upgrade.md (read in full; an 'Update 2026-11-17' banner wins over the text below it).
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
Part A (doctor): 1. In packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts checkManifestAgreement, add an OVPR branch first: when package.json has a @deftai/directive-runtime dependency and .deft/core does not exist, return skip (or pass) with a detail that names the pin as the version authority (AC1.6), put the leftover paths in data.legacy_markers, and name no `deft update`. Reuse an existing pin reader. 2. Repos that still have .deft/core keep today's behaviour. Doctor writes nothing.
Part B (D-022, upgrade only): 3. packages/runtime/src/removal-steps/steps.ts: add removeLegacyBareVersionMarkers(root): for each bareVersionMarkerTargets path, remove it only when it is a regular file whose trimmed content is a single version string; return removed paths. 4. Run it in runSetup's old-style branch (setup.ts) next to the .deft/core removal and in every convert strategy that removes copied core (strategies.ts), upgrade only, never repair, uninstall or doctor; removed paths flow into the upgrade report. 5. Before deleting the root marker, confirm its four other readers (paths.ts:24, payload-staleness.ts:181, resolve-version.ts:75, deposit-sha.ts:91) are copy-model only; if any OVPR path still needs it, stop and report. 6. installer-output-inventory.ts: add a `bare-version-marker` entry with disposition na-retired-copy-model and an AC8.10 justification.
7. Settle the leftover .deft-version handling here; P2-U12 (#6562) PR 2 later removes the linked-worktree branch of the same check. 8. Tests per the spec; P1-U3 fixture assertions if it has merged. Changelog fragment changelog.d/6001-doctor-ignores-old-version-markers.md.
Scope: Five production files: Part A is checks.ts; Part B is steps.ts, strategies.ts, setup.ts and installer-output-inventory.ts. One PR, or two (A then B).
narratives.Constraint:
- Do not make doctor write, delete or "fix" anything (AC8.8, AC12.1).
- Do not advise `deft update`, `directive update` or `install --repair` for a leftover marker under OVPR (AC12.7).
- Do not delete anything else under `xbrief/` or `vbrief/`. Do not delete a marker whose content is not a bare version.
- Do not start writing `.deft-version` again anywhere (AC1.6).
- Do not change uninstall to remove `xbrief/` content (AC11.7). Marker removal runs on upgrade only, never repair, uninstall or doctor (D-022).
- Keep the doctor change local to `checkManifestAgreement`.
- OVPR change gate: read ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/OVPR-CHANGE-GATE.md. Do not edit docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/ and do not ship behaviour that departs from the written OVPR requirements or architecture; stop that part and hand back a change proposal.
- Changelog: add the changelog.d fragment named in file_scope; never edit CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Dependencies: Depends on: none. Blocks: P2-U12 (#6562) PR 2 follows this unit's .deft-version handling. Decision D-022 (upgrade deletes version-only markers; doctor ignores them).
narratives.PlanningOrder: design-critique: not warranted, because the OVPR fix plan and this unit spec already decide the design (polfer decisions D-001, D-008)

items.title: After `directive upgrade --yes` on a 0.126.2-layout repo, `directive doctor --full` reports no `manifest-agreement` failure, and exit status is 0 if nothing else is wrong (AC14.29).

narrative.Acceptance: Given a 0.126.2-layout repo, when `directive upgrade --yes` runs and then `directive doctor --full` runs, then `manifest-agreement` does not fail and doctor exits 0 when nothing else is wrong.

items.title: In an OVPR repo that still has `xbrief/.deft-version` (converted by an older release, or reinstalled after uninstall), doctor does not fail on it and does not advise `deft update` or `directive update`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an OVPR repo with a runtime pin, no `.deft/core` and a leftover `xbrief/.deft-version`, when `directive doctor` runs, then `manifest-agreement` does not fail and its output does not contain `deft update` or `directive update`.

items.title: In a repo that still has `.deft/core`, `manifest-agreement` behaves as before.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a pre-conversion repo that still has `.deft/core`, when `directive doctor` runs, then `manifest-agreement` returns the same status and detail as before this change.
Given a project snapshot, when `directive doctor` runs, then the snapshot after the run is byte-identical to the one before.

items.title: Conversion removes `xbrief/.deft-version`, `vbrief/.deft-version` and root `.deft-version` when each holds only a version string. The upgrade report lists them. Other files are untouched.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an old-layout repo with version-only `xbrief/.deft-version`, `vbrief/.deft-version` and root `.deft-version`, when `directive upgrade --yes` runs, then each marker is deleted and listed in the upgrade report, a marker with other content is kept, and no other file changes.

items.title: The AC8.10 inventory has a `bare-version-marker` entry.

narrative.Acceptance: Given `packages/runtime/src/installer-output-inventory.ts`, when the inventory is read, then it has a `bare-version-marker` entry with disposition `na-retired-copy-model`.

issueCommentThread.body:
### Duplicate / uniqueness triage (2026-10-28)

**Verdict: UNIQUE — keep open.**

Not in the sealed install-ovpr-problem-ledger-2026-10-23 Problems 1–33 ticket map.

**Related (not duplicate):**
- Closed #2055 / #1437 / #5390 — historical `.deft-version` / manifest-agreement classes under the vendored-core model

This is the OVPR legacy-upgrade residual: `xbrief/.deft-version` left after 0.126.2 → 0.127.0 upgrade (and survives uninstall+reinstall) so doctor `manifest-agreement` fails while header may still say in sync. Keep.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/doctor packages/runtime/src/removal-steps packages/cli/src/legacy-conversion.test.ts
expected_outputs: After `directive upgrade --yes` on a 0.126.2-layout repo, `directive doctor --full` reports no `manifest-agreement` failure, and exit status is 0 if nothing else is wrong (AC14.29).

In an OVPR repo that still has `xbrief/.deft-version` (converted by an older release, or reinstalled after uninstall), doctor does not fail on it and does not advise `deft update` or `directive update`.
In a repo that still has `.deft/core`, `manifest-agreement` behaves as before.
Conversion removes `xbrief/.deft-version`, `vbrief/.deft-version` and root `.deft-version` when each holds only a version string. The upgrade report lists them. Other files are untouched.
The AC8.10 inventory has a `bare-version-marker` entry.
swarm.acceptance_criteria_justification: Six items: the six acceptance criteria of unit spec P2-U2, one each. Items 5 and 6 are Part B, decided by D-022 (upgrade deletes the version-only markers).
